results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
results.snippet: Press coverage detailing Professor Fabio Giglietto's research on Meta's political content reduction policies. The article discusses how his findings regarding a 72% decrease in visibility for Italian parliamentarians prompted a formal European Commission query and inquiries by Italian communications authority AGCOM.

results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: A news article detailing a study by sociologist Fabio Giglietto on how social media algorithms influence elections and democratic discourse, specifically demonstrating that Meta's political content reduction policies asymmetricially impacted democratic representatives while leaving extremist networks largely untouched.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: Official institutional news coverage from the University of Urbino detailing Professor Fabio Giglietto's landmark research on Meta's content policies. The piece explains how his computational analysis of over 2.5 million social media posts spurred a European Parliament inquiry.
